details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: Double free in another_hunk() via pch_swap()
     - debian/patches/CVE-2018-6952.patch: in pch_swap(), src/pch.c, derive
       the non-freeable pointer range shift from p_ptrn_lines instead of the
       already-incremented line index, so p_bfake/p_efake keep bracketing the
       aliased fill lines after a swap. With a blank line in the middle of a
       context-diff hunk the range was off by one and the next
       another_hunk() call freed an aliased line twice
     - CVE-2018-6952
